[SWS_DM_02167] Retrieval of
SOVD
entity
operations
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
If the SOVD method
Query for operations from an Entity
is received, the
DM shall send a response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and add for each
available
DiagnosticSovdOperation
a SOVD
OperationDescription item
with the attributes:
id
set to the shortName of the
DiagnosticSovdOperation
